finding.summary: The paper states that all models are initialized using Glorot initialization, but MLP_Predictor initializes its linear layers using PyTorch's default nn.Linear.reset_parameters(), which uses Kaiming uniform initialization.

evidence.text: In all our experiments, we use the AdamW optimizer (Kingma & Ba, 2015;Gugger & Howard, 2018) with weight decay set to 10 -5 , and all models initialized using Glorot initialization (Glorot & Bengio, 2010).

reason: Every side of the finding is shown by evidence found again in its source.

accepted_evidence.text: In all our experiments, we use the AdamW optimizer (Kingma & Ba, 2015;Gugger & Howard, 2018) with weight decay set to 10 -5 , and all models initialized using Glorot initialization (Glorot & Bengio, 2010).
